name: Switch
description: An on/off toggle whose thumb stretches while pressed and springs across on release.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, to the right of the switch.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: On state (controlled). Use defaultSelected when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the switch is turned on or off.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the switch and dims it to 50%.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Shows the state without letting it change.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components SwitchField.
